data.description: Validated against the installed kind schema; excludes secret values and forbidden fields.

items.description: Installed and authorized named action IDs, never a grant.

arguments.description: Validated against the closed installed action schema. Task user-field patches are then checked against the registered Task field schema; arbitrary state/role/source properties are refused.

delegation_id.description: Selector only; server resolves current authority.

policy_document.description: Validated against the registered policy-owner schema including variant/lifecycle; not interpreted by arbitrary client code.

document.description: Validated against the registered definition-kind schema.
